request.style: English, male tenor solo with solemn choir, piano, cello, flute, harp, strings, reverent and steady, 72 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
He rescues me unharmed from battle
Though many oppose my soul
God hears and humbles the proud ones
Who have no fear of Him

[Verse]
My companion raised a hand
Against his friends in trust
He violated the covenant
And broke his sacred word

[Chorus]
Cast your burden on the Lord
And he will sustain you
He will never let the
Righteous be shaken

[Verse]
His speech was smoother than butter
Yet war lived in his heart
His words were softer than oil
Yet they were drawn swords

[Chorus]
Cast your burden on the Lord
And he will sustain you
He will never let the
Righteous be shaken

[Bridge]
He will bring them down
To the pit of destruction
Men of blood and treachery
Will not live out half their days

[Outro]
But I will trust in you
